usedFor: karlia holds your customers, and Zoho Books keeps a matching record when “New Customer” runs “Create or Update Customer”.

bestTemplate.name: “New Customer” in karlia, then “Create or Update Customer” in Zoho Books
bestTemplate.why: A customer added in karlia is ready in Zoho Books before the first invoice is raised.

watchOut: “New Customer” in karlia fires only on creation, so later edits need their own template to reach Zoho Books.
